<!-- Thanks for contributing to Poulsback. Draft PRs and work in progress are
welcome. CONTRIBUTING.md explains the process, and you can ask for help here.
For a suspected vulnerability, please email Alex <alex@kmn.io> privately. -->

## Problem and change

<!-- Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues and mention
the source revision you started from, if known. -->

## Validation

<!-- Share the checks you ran and their results. Missing hardware or checks are
okay to state; we can discuss what else the change needs together.
Describe only the test scopes relevant to your change: builds/CPU checks,
kernel runtime, GPU execution or presentation.
For device results, include the machine/GPU and relevant software versions.
Use docs/tests.md to select checks appropriate to the change. -->

## Source and attribution

<!-- For new or adapted material, help reviewers identify its origin, license and
retained notices. Ask if you are unsure how to record these.
Mention any AI assistance that matters for reviewing the change, and how you
verified the result. Omit this explanation if it is not relevant to the change. -->

## Before merge

<!-- These items can be completed during review, before the patch is merged. -->

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under its stated license and have
  preserved applicable copyright and license notices.
- [ ] Each submitted commit has the appropriate DCO sign-offs, as described in
  CONTRIBUTING.md. Existing sign-offs and agreed author/coauthor credit are preserved.
